name: Patch-seq profiling of mouse locus coeruleus norepinephrine neurons
description: Advised on publishing Patch-seq data from the BICAN consortium, including a Dandiset for a study of mouse locus coeruleus norepinephrine neurons that gathers its cells from the consortium's earlier uploads into a BIDS layout, with tables mapping each cell to its records on another archive.
Prototyped a BIDS-Study organization of the consortium's Patch-seq collections on DANDI, and added a viewer for tables and a recommendation for cross-archive links to DANDI along the way.
Resulted in the publication of **5.7 GB** of mouse Patch-seq electrophysiology on the NIH data archive.
